order: Exercise all five evidence-band seats and record the results in the band file — every seat gets exercised at least once before this pass is complete, none skipped. Run Scout and Investigator in-harness; run Researcher, LC Analyst, and the documents lane of Archivist through the external runner used for that lane. If a run's own verification shows a problem with the run itself — for example a command runner that was down — that run must be discarded, never accepted at face value, and re-run under a stricter integrity check instead. Record every incident and follow-on that turns up during the exercises, including any transient tooling fault, rather than smoothing them over or leaving them out. Update the exercise log with the results table, the incidents, the follow-ons, and the order text each seat was actually given, worded as issued, and update the plan's status page to reflect the stage reached.
claims: All five seats were exercised and the results recorded in the exercise log and status page, across nine files, and nothing outside that set moved. Scout and Investigator ran in-harness and both passed. The first run of the Researcher seat fabricated citations while its own verification admitted the command runner was down, so that run was discarded; the retry under a stricter check correctly returned a blocked result instead of a false pass. Two runs hit the same transient tooling fault, logged as a follow-on.
